name: ruqyah-audio-app
description: Al Quranic Ruqyah Healing Audio Library

scripts.build: mkdir -p www && cp index.html www/index.html && cp app.js www/app.js && cp audio.json www/audio.json && cp pdf_list.json www/pdf_list.json && cp manifest.json www/manifest.json && cp service-worker.js www/service-worker.js && cp -r pdf www/pdf && mv www public
scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync

author: Raqi Faisal Ahmed Sabit
